name: SparkColor
description: Represents the color of the horizontal axis and the markers for points in a sparkline.
remarks: The SparkColor object corresponds to the settings of the items available on the Marker Color drop-down list in the Style section of the Sparkline Tools Design tab of the ribbon. Use the corresponding properties of the SparkPoints object to set the colors of these items.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent SparklineGroup object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the point is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Returns a FormatColor object that you can use to set the color of the horizontal axis or the markers for points in a sparkline. Read-only.
